content.comment_body: Hello, I've tried multiple times but I can't get the current [product_name] [version_no] to install on my Mac. My system is macOS Monterey [version_no]. I also tested it on another Mac with macOS Big Sur [version_no], but that didn't help. Whenever I attempt to open the "setup.app" file, I get an error like "Cannot open file." The web installer came from the [company_name] homepage. Does anyone have a solution? Thank you in advance!

Hi, I'm not a Mac user but recall there are a few common issues: 1. The Windows installer downloaded from [company_name] is an upgrade, which requires an official version already on your Mac—either an older installed version or the original [product_name] DVD. 2. If you downloaded the upgrade from [company_name] on your Mac, there have been reports that this may not work. It's often necessary to download the upgrade using a Windows PC or laptop, then transfer the file to your Mac to run the upgrade. 3. [product_name] supports specific operating systems—make sure your version of macOS is supported. Hope this helps.
